units.source_text: 源氏来到花散里所居的夏殿，恐是节候未到之故，此间甚是寂静。

en.t: Genji came to the summer residence where Hanachirusato lived; perhaps because the season had not yet arrived, the place was very quiet.

units.source_text: 纵观室内，并无风雅点缀，但觉到处落落大方。

en.t: Looking around the room, he saw no elegant adornments, yet everything felt simple, spacious, and refined.

units.source_text: 他和这位夫人情缘悠久，互相深深了解，彼此不拘形迹。

en.t: His bond with this lady went back many years; they understood each other deeply and stood on no ceremony with one another.

units.source_text: 现在不必强求床笫之欢，却有融融泄泄的唱随之乐。

en.t: Now there was no need to insist on the pleasures of the bedchamber; instead, they enjoyed the warm harmony of a devoted companionship.

units.source_text: 花散里室内张着帷屏，源氏把它推开，花散里亦不介意。

en.t: A curtain screen stood in Hanachirusato's room, and when Genji pushed it aside, she did not mind.

units.source_text: 她穿着源氏所赠的宝蓝衫子，色彩不甚鲜艳。

en.t: She was wearing the deep blue robe Genji had given her, though its color was not especially bright.

units.source_text: 她的头发也过了盛期，略见稀薄了。

en.t: Her hair, too, had passed its prime and was beginning to look a little thin.

units.source_text: 虽然不求艳丽，其实也该装些假发。

en.t: Even if she did not seek beauty or display, she really ought to have added some false hair.

units.source_text: 源氏每次和她相见，总是想道：

en.t: Whenever Genji met her, he always thought to himself:

units.source_text: “倘换了别人，一定嫌她相貌不扬。

en.t: "If it were someone else, he would surely find her plain in appearance.

units.source_text: 我今如此永远优待她，正是我的本意，深可喜慰。

en.t: That I continue to treat her with such lasting kindness is exactly what I myself wish, and it gives me deep comfort.

units.source_text: 如果她同别的轻薄女子一样，略不称心，就背弃我，那就不足道了。”

en.t: If she were like other frivolous women, abandoning me as soon as something displeased her, then she would not be worth speaking of."

units.source_text: 此时他就觉得自己之情长，与花散里之稳重，如意称心，不胜喜慰。

en.t: At such moments, he felt that his own constancy and Hanachirusato's steadiness suited his heart perfectly, and he was filled with glad comfort.

units.source_text: 两人亲睦地谈了一会之后，源氏就到西厅去探望玉鬘。

en.t: After the two had talked together affectionately for a while, Genji went to the western hall to visit Tamakazura.
